entries.zh: 评判；评断（受评判而论其所得）
entries.en: to deserve and be judged; to judge, evaluate (評)
entries.notes: 西语 judgado/dado 辨读存疑、闽南栏 ge/pe 存疑且声调号 T99 污损，仅据汉字「評」（评断、评判）释义。

entries.en: to deserve pity, to be pitiable; to pity, have compassion

entries.zh: 可憐（可怜之异体写法）；值得怜悯；怜悯
entries.en: to deserve pity, to be pitiable; to pity
to be a pity, regrettable; to regret

entries.zh: 拾得；拾取而得（如拾得的孩儿，或依惯例归己保有）
entries.en: to pick up and obtain, to find; deserved to be kept, as a picked-up child or by custom
entries.notes: 闽南栏首音节 quio/chioh 辨读存疑；据汉字「拾得」与西语「值得被保留（如拾得之子或依惯例）」释义。

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑〕貴鼻（辨读或作「貫鼻」，字面：贵／贯穿＋鼻）；西语「值得被给予，如同 bac…（缩写未展开）」词义无法定夺
entries.en: [uncertain] lit. 'precious nose' (or 貫鼻 'nose-pierced'); to deserve and be given like a 'bac.' (abbreviation unresolved)
entries.notes: 汉字貴/貫与西语缩写 bac. 均无法确解，语义无法定夺，仅按字面与音写 kuì-pí 给出存疑释义。

entries.zh: 效劳；出力服务（所立之功）
entries.en: to render service, serve; services rendered, merits
entries.notes: 闽南音写两音节 haù-lô 与汉字栏单字「效」不齐，推断原条为「效勞」，与西语 merecimientos（所效之劳／功劳）相合。

entries.en: to exert oneself, render service; efficacy, merit
entries.notes: 闽南栏混入残文（chiū lāt animo de…，似西语注文串入），据汉字「效力」与音写 haù-lēg 释义。

entries.en: great merits; (idiom) merit achieved and fame established

entries.zh: 功德；为亡者所立之功与敬仪（亡者功德法事）
entries.en: merit and virtue; merits and honors of the dead (funeral/religious services)

entries.zh: 点心；茶点小食（命人备办茶点）
entries.en: refreshments, snack; to order or serve a collation (light refreshment)
military merits, war merits; martial achievements
entries.notes: 西语词尾 Guerra/Guada 辨读存疑；据汉字「武功」与音写 bú-cōng 释义。
